title: The Speaker Played One Pure Sound, Yet Opening Their Eyes Flipped the Syllable
description:
You think your ears hear speech all by themselves! Yet your eyes secretly rewrite the words you hear! This is the true story of the mismatched speech illusion. Here is what went wrong with textbook hearing theories.
